artifact_observations.location: Red retaining straps and tool handles
artifact_observations.reasoning: The red elastic straps exhibit impossible physics. They appear to fuse into the black plastic housing and the tool handles without clear attachment points. Some loops seem to emerge from solid material or terminate abruptly. The screwdriver handles on the left appear to melt into the red strap structure, lacking distinct boundaries between the tool and the holder.

The metallic surfaces lack realistic specular highlights and reflections. The hammer head has a matte, slightly 'waxy' appearance rather than polished steel, and the edges are slightly soft/bleeding into the background.

The black handles of the screwdrivers/pry bars on the left seem to merge with each other and the red strap. It is difficult to distinguish where one tool ends and another begins due to boundary bleeding.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the red straps. In AI images, thin connecting structures like straps often fail to attach logically to anchors. Check if the straps have valid start/end points or if they just fade into the background. Also, verify if the tools are physically distinct objects or if they are melting into one another.
